extensions.tonalRampPurpose: Synthesized OKLCH strips for the design panel only. These are not additional application tokens.

metric.purpose: Performance summary values with tabular numerals; 30px below 560px.

shadows.name: app-frame
shadows.purpose: Soft separation for the rounded desktop frame; content scrolls inside its continuous background.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Background, border, and text color transitions.

motion.name: surface-open
motion.purpose: Dialog/popover opacity .4 to 1 and translation -4px to 0.

motion.name: reduced-motion

motion.purpose: Applied with important priority when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #958268); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brown, #75462c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }.ds-primary { border-color: transparent; background: var(--accent, #ffae38); color: var(--accent-ink, #392010); font-weight: 600; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #f69a20); } .ds-primary:active { background: #eb8910; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #958268); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brown, #75462c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } }.ds-secondary { background: var(--white, #fffef9); color: var(--text, #321d15); } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--brown, #75462c); background: var(--brown-light, #fff1d4); } .ds-secondary:active { background: #f5e4be; }

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Low-emphasis action used beside a primary control.
components.css: .ds-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #958268); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-quiet:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brown, #75462c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-quiet { transition: none; } }.ds-quiet { border-color: transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #73614f); } .ds-quiet:hover { background: var(--brown-light, #fff1d4); color: var(--text, #321d15); } .ds-quiet:active { background: #f5e4be; }

components.name: Destructive button
components.description: Confirmation action for deleting a class section.
components.css: .ds-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #958268); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-danger:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; } .ds-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brown, #75462c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-danger { transition: none; } }.ds-danger { border-color: #9c3028; background: #9c3028; color: #fff; } .ds-danger:hover { background: #7d261f; } .ds-danger:disabled { opacity: .6; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Visible label, strong border, and keyboard focus for class entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #321d15); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #958268); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--white, #fffef9); color: var(--text, #321d15); font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; caret-color: var(--brown, #75462c); transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #73614f); opacity: 1; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--red, #a04437); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brown, #75462c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 800px) { .ds-input { font-size: 16px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition: none; } }

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Cocoa text navigation with a clear orange current-page state.
components.html: DashboardLearnersLive sessionsReports
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; width: 192px; background: var(--sidebar-brown, #704329); font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: block; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: #f9e6b8; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff6df; background: #865537; } .ds-nav-link.ds-current { color: var(--accent-ink, #392010); background: var(--accent, #ffae38); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6e5d5; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Status labels
components.description: Read-only status text with semantic foreground/background pairs.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; border-radius: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-good { background: var(--green-bg, #eaf2eb); color: var(--green, #3e684e); } .ds-warn { background: var(--orange-bg, #fbf0d9); color: var(--orange, #875d16); }

components.name: Content panel
components.description: Shared bordered panel for readable application content.
components.html:
Recent activity

Activity appears here as learners complete sessions.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3dccb); border-radius: var(--radius, 16px); background: var(--white, #fffef9); color: var(--text, #321d15); font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 24px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-card { padding: 20px; } }

components.name: Metric panel
components.description: Text-only summary; the example shows the application's initial loading placeholder.
components.css: .ds-metric { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--radius, 16px); background: var(--white, #fffef9); box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #50311c12; font-family: Poppins, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-metric-label { color: var(--muted, #73614f); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-metric-value { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--brown-dark, #321d15); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-metric { padding: 20px 16px; } .ds-metric-label { font-size: 12px; } .ds-metric-value { font-size: 30px; } }

components.name: Session progress
components.description: Thicker session progress track; 50% here is a component preview value.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 10px; margin: 12px 0 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--brown-light, #fff1d4); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { display: block; width: 50%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #ad621d; }

narrative.overview:
BakeIT adapts the user-selected bakery reference into a warm, practical instructor interface. Ivory surfaces, a deep cocoa navigation area, amber-orange actions, and Poppins give the existing class and learner tools a consistent identity.

Solid panels, visible table rules, and restrained blurred shadows support scanning. The original BakeIT logo remains the identity asset. Photography belongs to sign-in; records and performance views rely on real application content.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory workspace, cocoa navigation, and orange active states.
Locally hosted Poppins with clear size and weight hierarchy.
Rounded panels, explicit borders, and compact task controls.
Short feedback motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Orange Action Rule
rules.body: Pair orange actions and active navigation with dark cocoa text; reserve semantic green, amber, and red for status feedback.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Keep the keyboard outline visible on every interactive control, using the light outline on the cocoa sidebar.

dos: Do preserve the BakeIT logo and the supplied ivory, cocoa, and orange direction.
Do use the shared spacing scale, rounded panels, table dividers, and locally hosted Poppins.
Do retain visible labels, keyboard focus, readable status text, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep record tables usable through their own horizontal scrolling region on narrow screens.
Do record image origins and generation prompts in the asset provenance document.
donts: Don't use purple-to-blue gradients or text gradients.
Don't add heading emojis, headline badges, or three icon boxes.
Don't use Inter, italic serif accents, or Space Grotesk with Instrument Serif.
Don't introduce colored left-border cards, glassmorphism, or low-contrast dark mode.
Don't add ubiquitous Lucide icons or default shadcn styling.
Don't add scroll fades, cursor beams, or fading button hovers.
Don't introduce inconsistent spacing, repeated em-dash prose, or buzzword copy.
